title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for angular separation must be correctly stated as 2".

title: Resolving Power Equation
description: Important Criteria: The equation for angular resolving power, Delta theta = 1.22 * (lambda / D), must be correctly applied.

title: Wavelength Conversion
description: Important Criteria: The wavelength must be correctly converted from angstroms to centimeters.

title: Comparison of Resolutions
description: Important Criteria: The comparison between the telescope's resolving power and the eye's resolving power must be correctly made.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All units must be consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Failing to correctly apply the factor of 1.22 in the resolving power equation is a common error.

title: Significant Figures
description: Optional Criteria: The final answer should reflect appropriate significant figures based on the given data.
